recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Future fixes should target the FHIR Extension Pack for the extension definition or IG Publisher for rendering behavior unless core maturity-model text or fhir.ini-driven declarations become misleading.
issue_request: FHIR-28945 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core change request asking to make supporting information for FMM declarations visible for core and IG artifacts, including quality-criteria links for FMM3+ assertions and a standard extension/rendering path for supporting maturity documentation.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-28945 was found. The same implementation path appears in Lloyd McKenzie's 2021 commit adding structuredefinition-fmm-support and conformance-derivedFrom extensions to core, followed by the R5 extension-source cleanup that moved extension definitions out of the core checkout.
additional_context: The current maturity model page defines all FMM levels, links FMM3 to Conformance Resource Quality Guidelines, and points to maturity analysis/implementation context. Current core FMM values are driven by source/fhir.ini. The active structuredefinition-fmm-support extension definition is in the FHIR Extension Pack, and the Jira-linked HL7/fhir-ig-publisher#1135 PR was merged in 2025 to fix rendering/reading of resource-level FMM support.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing the extension definition into core would conflict with current extension-pack ownership, and adding duplicate core prose would not change implementer understanding because the core maturity page, fhir.ini source, extension-pack definition, and publisher support together satisfy the applied issue.

evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final issue request and the need to check both core guidance and the computable support-extension path.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I minutes record FHIR-28945 as Persuasive; later WGM minutes record assignment to Lloyd to create the extension.

evidence_items.summary: The current FMM model defines levels, links FMM3 to Conformance Resource Quality Guidelines, and describes testing and implementation evidence for higher maturity.

evidence_items.summary: The FHIR Extension Pack contains the active structuredefinition-fmm-support extension with markdown documentation supporting an artifact's FMM level.
evidence_items.learned: The standard extension mechanism requested by FHIR-28945 is present but maintained outside the core FHIR checkout.

evidence_items.summary: Core history added structuredefinition-fmm-support in 2021 and later removed extension definitions from R5 source during extension ownership cleanup.
evidence_items.learned: The current core absence of the extension definition is an intentional source-ownership migration, not an unapplied issue.

evidence_items.summary: The 2025 Jira-linked PR was merged and adjusted publisher StatusRenderer handling for FMM and standards-status support extensions.
evidence_items.learned: The remaining UI/rendering concern was handled in the publisher, outside the core source checkout.
